data.revised_prompt: Clean HD game FX concept on a solid flat #FF00FF magenta background only. No text, no labels, no UI, no scenery. A left-to-right water cyclone attack effect, FX only, no characters. Single coherent swirling ribbon of water and spray traveling from left enemy side toward right player side. Strong forward push left to right, spiral core, translucent aqua and cyan highlights, deeper blue shadowing, bright white foam accents. Densest swirl near the left-middle, with a forward-reaching streaming tail toward the right. Composition like a preview effect for two avatar portraits on opposite sides: leave generous open space at far left and far right for later compositing. Cyclone centered horizontally across the middle band, large and readable, energetic polished gameplay-ready VFX sprite. No portraits, faces, bodies, cards, borders, arrows, labels, interface elements, or detached background elements. Sharp clean edges, high definition, dynamic water ribbons, spray particles integrated into the cyclone only.
